sources.title: CDN Tsunami: Exploiting HTTP/3-HTTP/1.1 Conversion for DoS Attacks
sources.snippet: Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) provide high availability, accelerate content delivery for their host websites, but are also vulnerable to different types of Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks. Prior works have studied a variety of DoS attacks with HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2 connections, but most of them are being fixed, making CDNs robust against such attacks.
